name: Velesto Energy Berhad
overview: 2026年，Velesto Energy Berhad 的公告主要涉及公司治理变动、股息派发和股票上市，未披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比下降23.0%，净利润同比下降98.9%。
overview_en: In 2026, Velesto Energy Berhad's announcements mainly involved corporate governance changes, dividend payments, and share listings, with no disclosed expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts for any business segment. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw revenue decline 23.0% year-on-year and net profit decline 98.9% year-on-year.
